name: glass
title: Liquid Glass
description: Decides what a glass surface is made of and resolves the material tokens into a fill, border, blur strength, and tint. On iOS 26 it hands the surface to the real system material via `expo-glass-effect` (which requires the New Architecture); everywhere else — and in any app without it — it renders a translucent overlay over a host blur layer. Pulled in by components that support `surface="glass"`.
